author: The Daily Beast
title: Historical Parallels: Hitler's Rise and Trump's Power
text:
• On January 30, 1933, Adolf Hitler held his first Cabinet meeting in the Reich Chancellery in Berlin.
• Hitler was surrounded by friends and supporters, including Hermann Goering, Ernst Rohm, and Heinrich Himmler.
• The Cabinet meeting focused on strategies to consolidate power and eliminate opposition.
• Hitler expressed concerns about the opposition from the Center Party and the Communist Party.
• On March 23, 1933, the Reichstag voted on Hitler's Enabling Act, passing it with a vote of 441 to 84.
• This vote marked the end of democracy in Germany.
• The article draws parallels between Hitler's rise to power and Donald Trump's presidency.
• Trump is described as holding unchallenged power in the White House.
• During a Cabinet meeting, Trump displayed casual authority and mocked his subordinates.
• The article suggests that Trump's administration has undermined checks and balances.
• Historical references are made to Nazi sympathizers in 1930s America, particularly in Long Island.
• The article warns of the potential dangers of unchecked presidential power.
